messages.subject: mdply in dplyr
parts:
Hi,

I'm a big fan of plyr, and if it wasn't so slow I wouldn't care for anything else. Most of what I do with plyr seems pretty straightforward in dplyr, but one thing that I can't find in the docs is the equivalent of mdply. Does it mean I'm stuck loading the two packages (potential clashes), or have I missed an equivalent statement? If it's also faster, great, but I think most of the time the applied function is the bottleneck anyway.

Minimal example,

require(plyr)
p = expand.grid(mean=1:5, sd=seq(0, 1, length=10))
mdply(p, rnorm, n=5)

Regards,

baptiste
